source_script: 清晨，小木站在木门前，抬手轻轻敲门，木头发出两声轻响。门打开后，小木挥手说：“早上好。”

shots.raw_description: 清晨，小木站在木门前，轻敲两下后停手等待。
shots.audio_prompt: Soft morning ambience with two light wooden knocks.

shots.raw_description: 门打开后，小木挥手说早上好。
shots.image_prompt: A small olive-green wooden robot with a square head and an orange scarf stands in the doorway of an open door, one arm raised in a waving gesture.
shots.video_prompt: In a locked-off shot, the wooden robot gently waves one hand in the open doorway. Preserve its square head and orange scarf. One continuous shot with no cuts.
shots.audio_prompt: Wooden door creaks open, followed by quiet morning ambience.
